displayName.ja: 【シャイニングサン】 日ノ出　陽葵

profile.ja:
五車学園で学ぶ学生対魔忍。 
陽遁の術という火遁に連なる術を使う。 
その潜在能力は凄まじく、かつて陽遁の術を発現させた対魔忍は数里を焼き尽くし、自身も焼滅したという古い文献が残っている。 
しかし現在の彼女の能力では、発光による目潰しや小さな火球を放つ程度。 
一時的に術の出力を上げることはできるが、その場でぶっ倒れる事もあるので、戦闘では体術や武器による攻撃をメインとしている。 
底抜けに明るい性格で、周囲からは「暑苦しいけど心強い」と評価されている。 
彼女の陽光を浴び続けると日焼けをするので、クラスメイト達は訓練の前に日焼け止めをしっかり塗りこんでいるが、当の本人は一切気にせず全身こんがりと焼けている。 
肉付きの良い体型と、男女関係なく近い距離感で男子達からは密かに人気がある。 
陽葵は陽遁の術を徐々に使いこなせるようになり、火炎や発光、さらにはそれを組み合わせた陽炎による幻惑も身につけたので、術の進化に合わせてスーツのデザインも改良した。 
なお、前の装備の行方は誰も知らないようだ。
profile.en: She is a student Taimanin at Gosha Academy, using the art of Yangdon, a technique related to fire manipulation. The potential of Yangdon is said to be immense, with ancient literature stating that a Taimanin who once wielded this power was able to burn everything in sight, including herself. However, her current abilities only allow her to create blindingly bright lights or small fireballs, and she primarily relies on martial arts and weapon-based attacks in combat. She can temporarily increase her technique's output, but this can also cause her to collapse, making it a last resort. She has a bright and cheerful personality, earning her the evaluation of being "hot-headed but reliable" from those around her. Her classmates apply sunscreen before training due to her intense sunlight, but she herself doesn't mind and has a nicely tanned body. Her athletic build and friendly demeanor have made her popular among the boys, who often try to get close to her, but she remains oblivious to their intentions, thinking she's just being a good friend. As she masters Yangdon, she has also learned to use flames, light, and even the illusions created by Kagero, and her suit design has been improved to match her growing abilities. However, the fate of her previous equipment remains unknown.

text.ja: 新しい学年、新しい衣装、新しい後輩！　先輩として、頼れる背中を見せていかないとだよね。張り切っていくよ♪
text.en: It's a new school year, a new outfit, and new underclassmen! As a senior, I need to show them that they can rely on me, so I'll do my best!

text.ja: 陽遁のこと、もっとよく知っておくべきだったんだよね……いろんなことができるようになって、身に染みてわかったかも
text.en: I should've learned more about Yangdon... now that I've gotten used to it, I realize just how much I can do with it.

text.ja: 残念、そっちは幻だよ♪　へへー、どうかな？　陽遁は攻撃だけじゃなくて、幻惑もできるんだよ。こんなに奥が深かったんだね
text.en: Sorry, that's just an illusion! Hehe, how's that? Yangdon isn't just for attacks; it can also create illusions. It's deeper than I thought!

text.ja: 潜入任務では、武器が使えないことも……なんなら、そのほうが多かったりするし、武器に頼らない戦い方も覚えていかないとね
text.en: In infiltration missions, I often can't use weapons... in fact, that's usually the case, so I need to learn how to fight without relying on them.

text.ja: いままでより、もーっと頼れるようになったから、いつでも声かけてね。私、がんばるよっ♪
text.en: I've become more reliable now, so don't hesitate to call on me anytime. I'll do my best!

text.ja: 任務に加えて、後輩の指導とか、引率も増えて……なんていうか、先輩たちの気持ちがわかるようになった……の、かも？
text.en: With missions and guiding underclassmen, I've taken on more responsibilities... I think I'm starting to understand how the seniors feel?

text.ja: どうかなぁ、この服♪　なんていうか、成長した感じがするっていうか、照れくさいような誇らしいような……だね♪
text.en: How's this outfit? It feels like I've grown up, but at the same time, it's a bit embarrassing... I'm not sure, but it's kind of nice?

text.ja: お仕事？　わかった、任せて……気持ちも乗ってるからか、最近すっごい調子いいんだ♪
text.en: Work? Got it, leave it to me! I'm feeling great, and my mood is perfect lately!

text.ja: や、やだぁ……新しい服は、こういうのじゃなくてぇ……んひっっ♪　ひゃ、めっ……ぁおっっ♪　らめっ、乳首っ、らめぇっ♪
text.en: No, no, no... this new outfit isn't like that... Ahh, not like this! Hya, me... Ahh, oh no! My nipples, no! Ahh, stop it!

text.ja: は、はひっ、いぃっ……は、ハメ乞いダンス、しますぅ……♪　ひまりのオマンコ、いっぱい使ってくださぁい……♪
text.en: Ah, ah, ah... I'll do the, uh, Begging Dance for you... ♪ Please, use Hinode's pussy as much as you want... ♪

text.ja: んっおぉぉぉぉっっ！　しゅふぅっ、んっ、しゅごっっ、ほぉっっ♪　おっ、おひっ、おっぎぃぃっ……んっっ、おぢんぽぉっっ♪
text.en: Nnnooohhh! Shufu, nn, shugo, hoo! Ah, ah, ogi, ogi... Nn, odipho! ♪
